details.report:
Implemented Issue #31 contracts and committed forward.

Behavior: Judge `continue` now requires typed nonempty unique comma-free `classes`; Fixer `completed` alone may carry validated `classesRepaired`, while Coder remains closed; Reviewer accepts exact-byte scope keys, injects absent/full or selected scope into parent and real child system prompts, and rejects malformed/duplicate input before child dispatch. Removed the transitional playbook and CLAUDE pointer; added caller-composition README guidance without topology prescription. Souls and ADRs were unchanged.

TDD/behavior evidence: added validator/tool-seam class contract tests plus one Reviewer scope tracer covering absent/full prompt behavior, exact-byte parent/Agent/Standards+Spec child propagation, and pre-child malformed rejection. Focused suite: 65/65 passed. The first full run exposed two intentional public-inventory expectation updates and the pre-existing node_modules symlink ignore shape; those were corrected, then lifecycle focus passed 14/14 and the current-head full suite passed 373/373.

Same-pattern check: reused package production validators, exact-object checks, existing Reviewer before_agent_start/Agent runner seams, and existing generated package-contract build path; no parallel parser or workflow mechanism introduced. Introduced-regression check: current-head `npm test` 373/373 and typecheck passed. Behavior-fact check: focused real-validator/tool/runtime tests passed 65/65, including both real Reviewer child prompts. Package evidence: `npm run build:recorder`, `npm pack --dry-run` (65 files), and `git diff --check` passed; committed dist package-contract artifacts were regenerated. Working tree was clean after commit.
